declarations.type:
∀ {graph : SearchRouteDAG.RankedDAG} {source target : Fin graph.nodeCount} {hops : Nat},
  SearchRouteDAG.Walk graph source target hops → graph.rank source + hops ≤ graph.rank target
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAG.walk_rank_progress

declarations.type:
∀ {graph : SearchRouteDAG.RankedDAG} {node : Fin graph.nodeCount} {hops : Nat},
  SearchRouteDAG.Walk graph node node hops → hops = 0
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAG.ranked_dag_has_no_positive_cycle

declarations.type:
∀ {graph : SearchRouteDAG.RankedDAG} {source target : Fin graph.nodeCount} {hops : Nat},
  SearchRouteDAG.Walk graph source target hops → hops + graph.rank source ≤ graph.maxRank
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAG.walk_hops_are_bounded

declarations.type:
∀ {graph : SearchRouteDAG.RankedDAG} {source target : Fin graph.nodeCount}
  {requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement} {budget : SearchRouteDAG.GraphRouteBudget}
  {generated : List SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate} {selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate},
  SearchRouteDAG.CandidateComplete graph source target requirement budget generated →
    SearchRouteDAG.LocallyOptimal graph source target requirement budget generated selected →
      SearchRouteDAG.Realizes graph source target selected ∧
        ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
          SearchRouteDAG.Realizes graph source target candidate →
            SearchRouteDAG.graphFeasibleB requirement budget candidate = true →
              SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse selected candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAG.complete_generation_lifts_local_to_global

declarations.type:
SearchRouteDAG.chooseBestGraphCandidate SearchRouteCost.nonGraphRequirement SearchRouteDAG.generousGraphBudget
    [SearchRouteDAG.shortInteractionLongGraph, SearchRouteDAG.longInteractionShortGraph] =
  some SearchRouteDAG.longInteractionShortGraph
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAG.corrected_router_selects_shorter_validated_graph_path

declarations.type:
SearchRouteDAG.unvalidatedShortestGraph.graphHops < SearchRouteDAG.longInteractionShortGraph.graphHops ∧
  SearchRouteDAG.graphFeasibleB SearchRouteCost.nonGraphRequirement SearchRouteDAG.generousGraphBudget
        SearchRouteDAG.unvalidatedShortestGraph =
      false ∧
    SearchRouteDAG.chooseBestGraphCandidate SearchRouteCost.nonGraphRequirement SearchRouteDAG.generousGraphBudget
        [SearchRouteDAG.unvalidatedShortestGraph, SearchRouteDAG.longInteractionShortGraph] =
      some SearchRouteDAG.longInteractionShortGraph
declarations.name: SearchRouteDAG.unvalidated_graph_path_is_not_a_shortcut
